Real rows from the SIIS archive on dane.gov.pl (data set 588, resource 42009, `2021.rar`, data as of 31.12.2021,
CC0), cut to the nodes around Kąty Wrocławskie (`site-95bad491aa77`, lat 51.0424, lon 16.8854) and their
interfaces. Node 25131919 has a fibre interface but no coordinates; nodes 25793734 and 25794769 are radio only;
node 29163445 has a copper and a fibre interface. All operators here are companies; the sole-trader case is
built inline in `tests/unit/test_uke.py` with an invented name.
